pkgmetadata.longdescription: Reimplementation of the Qualcomm FastRPC userspace part. libhexagonrpc provides a wrapper around the FastRPC ioctl interface that builds the ioctl arguments from a remote method definition instead of requiring QAIC-generated code. hexagonrpcd opens the FastRPC device nodes and runs a reverse tunnel that serves requests coming from the DSP, including the apps_std and apps_mem interfaces and the HexagonFS file tree usually provided by the device's Android firmware. chrecd is the reverse tunnel client for the Context Hub Runtime Environment.

use.flag: Build hexagonrpcd with extra logging for every remote method invocation
